query: with svt_lessons as (select s.name as series_name,c.id as chapter_id,c.title as chapter_title,c.display_order as chapter_order,l.id as lesson_id,l.title as lesson_title,l.display_order as lesson_order,l.is_active,coalesce(length(l.content),0) as content_length from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2') and l.title in ('Leçon 2 : L’évolution de la lignée humaine.','Leçon 1 : L’hérédité du sexe et du groupe sanguin chez l’Homme.','Leçon 2 : Les prévisions génétiques.')), citation_summary as (select sub.name as subject_name,count(distinct c.id) as citation_count,count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.is_active and c.is_validated) as published_count,count(distinct c.id) filter (where not c.is_active and not c.is_validated) as draft_count,count(distinct ct.theme) as theme_count from public.subjects sub left join public.citations c on c.subject_id=sub.id left join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where sub.name in ('Français','Philosophie','Histoire-Géographie','Physique-Chimie') group by sub.name), citation_themes_by_subject as (select sub.name as subject_name,ct.theme,count(*) as citation_count from public.citations c join public.subjects sub on sub.id=c.subject_id join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where sub.name in ('Français','Philosophie','Histoire-Géographie','Physique-Chimie') group by sub.name,ct.theme order by sub.name,ct.theme) select jsonb_build_object('svt_lessons',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(svt_lessons) order by series_name,chapter_order,lesson_order) from svt_lessons),'citation_summary',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(citation_summary) order by subject_name) from citation_summary),'citation_themes',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(citation_themes_by_subject) order by subject_name,theme) from citation_themes_by_subject)) as audit limit 1;
